{
  "tools": [
    {"name": "Shader Skills (gokayfem/shader-skills)", "url": "https://github.com/gokayfem/shader-skills"}
  ],
  "on_screen_text": "GitHub - gokayfem/shader-skills - GitHub | github.com/gokayfem/shader-skills | View all files | README | MIT License | Shader Skills | A skill that teaches coding agents to write procedural GLSL shaders that compile on the first try and look intentional. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini and others. It pairs a shader-craft workflow with a verified GLSL building-block library: 186 functions across 20 modules, each one compiled in WebGL2 and numerically tested on the GPU. A bundler inlines exactly the functions a shader uses, so the result pastes straight into Shadertoy. | SDF still life: smooth blends with blended materials, PBR, soft shadows, AO, AgX | Volumetric cumulus: energy-conserving integration, Beer-Powder, dual-lobe phase | Physically based sky with aerial perspective | 2D distance-field poster: Oklab gradients, polar leaves, Bezier trunks | Texture-free materials: warped marble, Voronoi cracks, hex tiles, Truchet, filtered checker | Ocean: dispersive waves with analytic curvature foam, Fresnel sky, glitter path widening with distance | Each image links to its paste-ready shader. The sources are in skills/shader-art-coding/templates/ | Why | Agents write shaders blind: they cannot see the output, they misremember formulas, and WebGL rejects code that desktop GLSL accepts. Common results are struct ternaries, sine hashes that differ per GPU, SDFs with wrong signs, double gamma, and fog that ignores the sky. This skill closes those gaps.",
  "key_claims": [
    "Shader Skills gives coding agents the confidence to write graphics code that actually runs",
    "It feeds agents a library of 186 pre-tested functions that compile perfectly on the first try",
    "The library spans 20 modules, each compiled in WebGL2 and numerically tested on the GPU",
    "It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini and other coding agents",
    "Every tool/function is verified to work before use",
    "When asked to build things like a swirling ocean or rocky mountain, the agent grabs the right pieces and assembles them without breaking",
    "A bundler inlines exactly the functions used so the result pastes straight into Shadertoy",
    "Results in no more broken code, just beautiful, working, intentional-looking art",
    "The project is open source at gokayfem/shader-skills"
  ],
  "info_channel": "on-screen"
}
